image_availability: MISSING: four most recent attachment directories empty; no supplied screenshot/formula-image path in message; bounded Downloads top-level inventory has no identified new material

documented_before_numerics.potential: final XC potential on DFT grid
documented_before_numerics.noXC: loaded fixed DM; mf.xc empty; no new SCF
documented_before_numerics.source_precision: raw materials unavailable beyond CSV; no dates/version/method inferred

predeclared_precision.CBS: Python binary64 math.exp/math.sqrt; scalar multiply/subtract/divide in written order; energy bound 1e-10 Ha +32 eps64*max(1,abs(stored),abs(SCF5),abs(SCF4)); delta bound 1e-11 Ha+64 eps64*scale
predeclared_precision.sanity_log: 12-decimal logged scalars; CBS comparison 0.5e-12+8 eps64*scale; residual scalar comparison 1e-10+16 eps64*scale; F32 storage after F64 subtraction, exact equality; no separate F32 rounding of operands
predeclared_precision.pilot_noXC: existing independently computed ENuc+Ts+Vext+EH; 1e-10Ha+16eps64*sum absolute components
predeclared_precision.identities: exact case-sensitive names; .h5 suffix removal only; no fuzzy matching

literal_formula_source: formulas verbatim in user task, not image-read transcription
CBS_corr_mapping: source e_cbs_none -> existing E_CBS_corr column; no column rename
delta_conventions: numeric signed differences: formula=CBS2−CBS1; delta1=CBS_corr−CBS1; delta2=CBS2−CBS_corr. All differences positive here, so this alone cannot distinguish an undocumented abs convention.
noXC_reconstruction_is_not_circular: all90 consumes saved noXC log; pilot independently sums archived DM-derived components. Never computes noXC=CBS−target.
historical_lineage_remaining: original screenshot bytes, original H5/export producer and all90 independently computed noXC provenance not fully recovered
sanitized_digest_scope: only relevant user-transmitted declarations; NOT a hash of missing correspondence screenshots
